meta.name: remove-ai-slops
meta.description: Removes AI-generated code smells from branch changes or an explicit file list behind regression tests. Use when the user asks to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 清理代码中AI生成的坏味道与冗余痕迹
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常担心AI助手留下的代码不够干净
copy.tagline_en: Clean up AI-generated code smells and redundant patterns in your recent changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often worry about messy code left by AI assistants

howto.what: 它会先给改动过的文件补上回归测试、锁定当前行为,再按九类清单分批清理 AI 生成的代码痕迹,最后用测试、lint、类型检查等质量门禁验证;验证不通过就回退或直接改写。
howto.when: 当你要求清理、deslop 或移除最近改动里的 AI-slop 模式时触发。默认范围是当前分支相对 merge-base main 的 diff,也可以由调用方传入明确的文件列表。

say.text: 清理一下这个分支最近的改动,去掉 AI 味
say.note: 默认按 merge-base main 的 diff 范围跑

say.text: 把 src/foo.py 和 src/bar.py deslop 一遍
say.note: 用你给的文件列表作为处理范围

say.text: 移除最近改动里的 AI-slop,先补测试锁住行为
say.note: 会先写回归测试再动手清理

howto.what_en: It first adds regression tests to lock current behavior in changed files, then runs categorized cleanup passes on AI-generated smells, then verifies via test, lint and typecheck gates; reverts if verification fails.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to clean up, deslop, or remove AI-slop patterns from recent changes. Default scope is the branch diff vs merge-base main, or an explicit file list.

say_en.text: Clean up the AI slop in this branch's recent changes
say_en.note: Runs on the diff vs merge-base main
Uses your file list as the scope

say_en.text: Remove AI-slop from my recent changes, lock behavior with tests first
